facts.fact: Revised: Rohan concedes two days in Ranu, not three. The Fair is four days off at chapter start; they leave at first light on the third day, and a day and a half of road puts them at Garh Neshar the evening before the Fair. The two marked cases take their last dose at dusk on the second day. Meera names the patrol's third-day pass rule (F179) as part of her cost: Nimmi must finish the waves behind a shut door.
Revised: Meera says six days would be needed to treat everyone properly; Nimmi carries the remaining waves alone after the second day's dusk.
When Rohan says 'I will not' (pull the rope at the second dusk), the rope hums low and level; Meera feels it, writes 'Two days. R. promised.' in the count and takes his hand (applies F149).
